resumeText:
Sneha Iyer | Mumbai | sneha.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Assistant Manager - Compliance, Konkan Finserv Ltd (NBFC), Mumbai (2022 - present)
- Track new RBI circulars and master directions and circulate impact notes to business heads.
- Map applicable RBI Master Direction requirements for NBFCs into the compliance checklist.
- Run quarterly compliance testing of loan sanction and disbursement processes.
- Prepare and submit monthly and quarterly regulatory returns to RBI on the CIMS portal.
- Coordinated data requests and closure of observations during the annual RBI inspection.
- Follow up with credit, operations and IT teams on closure of compliance gaps.
- Conducted compliance awareness sessions for 150 branch staff.

Audit Assistant, Iyer & Bhat Chartered Accountants, Mumbai (2020 - 2022)
- Checked loan files and branch records during audits of two NBFC clients.

EDUCATION
B.Com, Mumbai University, 2019; Company Secretary (Executive), ICSI

SKILLS
Compliance policy drafting, Excel, PMLA
